title: Notion Start Agent, plans and task checklist fixes
summary: Start Agent works again in Notion AI, the AI keeps going after plans, and task checklists show real progress.
added: Task checklists build numbered steps from your request and the AI’s plan, with a goal header and “x of y done” progress.
improved: Each Notion chat thread is tracked separately, so new chats no longer reuse an older chat's session.
Large Notion startup messages are written safely without freezing the tab, with a chunked fallback for slow editors.
In Plan Mode and Ultracode, the AI is reminded once to start building after it writes a plan instead of stopping.
The command list tells the AI which addons, such as Blender, are connected.
The automatic prompt enhancer only runs before creation saves and never blocks the original command.
fixed: Notion Start Agent sends the startup command list automatically instead of leaving it in the chat box, including when Notion reformats it.
Notion's new /ai landing page and New chat button are recognised again.
Notion draft checks read emoji and smart quotes the way Notion displays them.
Sent Notion messages are recognised even when Notion changes spacing or formatting, so commands are no longer reported as not run.
PlazCode finds Notion's send button even when its label changes, and never overwrites text you typed yourself.
A short extra line after “PlazCode is ready.” no longer causes a startup handshake failure loop.
Skill and reference notes are sent once per task instead of replacing every command result.
Task checklists no longer stay at 0% or “Waiting for the AI…”.
notes: Start Agent was confirmed on a live Notion account (Windows, Chrome, AgentScript) before the plan, checklist and reformatted-draft fixes were added; those later fixes passed automated tests only.
Automated platform/browser regressions passed. Live Roblox Studio imports and the Blender addon connection were not re-tested.

sections.title: 🛠️ Notion Start Agent fixed
items: **Startup:** the command list sends itself instead of staying in the chat box, even when Notion reformats it.
**New Notion layout:** the /ai page, chat threads and New chat button are recognised again.
**Sends recognised:** emoji, curly quotes and formatting changes no longer make commands look unsent.
**Startup loop fixed:** a short extra line after “PlazCode is ready.” is accepted.

sections.title: 🧠 Plans and tasks
items: **Keeps going:** in Plan Mode and Ultracode the AI starts building after writing its plan.
**Working checklist:** numbered steps from your request and the AI’s plan, with progress.
**Clean results:** skill notes are sent once per task instead of replacing command results.

sections.title: ⚙️ Tools
items: **Addons:** the AI is told when Blender is connected.
**Prompt enhancer:** only runs before creation saves and never blocks a command.

sections.title: 🧪 Checks
items: Platform/browser regressions passed. Start Agent was confirmed on a live Notion account; the later fixes were tested automatically only.
